name: Opt In with Percentage
goal: User opts in to VPF and sets a valid percentage contribution.
constraints: All inputs are valid; user selects 'Percentage' and enters a value between 1 and 12.

phases.description: User is presented with the VPF intro and chooses 'PROCEED'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays intro message and user selects 'PROCEED'.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details for confirmation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and user confirms 'Yes'.
Bot displays opt-in/out options and user selects 'Opt IN'.
Bot displays 'Amount'/'Percentage' options and user selects 'Percentage'.

phases.description: User enters a valid percentage between 1 and 12.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts the percentage and proceeds to submission.

phases.description: Bot submits VPF update and receives 'opt-in' confirmation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays 'We have successfully Opted In for your Voluntary Provident Fund contribution.'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
